title_en: Active-Duty Enlisted Recruitment Schedule for All Armed Forces Branches (November 2026)
summary: The department is sharing the recruitment schedule of each branch of the armed forces for active-duty enlisted soldiers who apply in November 2026 and enlist in February 2027. Students who must fulfil a military service obligation may consult the attached schedule for reference. The specific deadlines and procedures are in the attachment, which was not read for this translation.
applies_to: Not stated explicitly. The notice is shared for students' reference in fulfilling their military service obligation; it does not state that any action is mandatory.

dates.what: Application month for active-duty enlisted recruitment in each armed forces branch (exact dates are in the attachment, which was not read)
Enlistment month for those who apply in November 2026

steps: Open the attachment '26년 11월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwpx ('November 2026 Active-Duty Enlisted Recruitment Plan for Each Branch, for distribution') on the original notice to find the specific recruitment schedule and procedures. Its content was not read for this translation.
translation:
Title: Active-Duty Enlisted Recruitment Schedule for Each Armed Forces Branch (November 2026)

We are forwarding, as attached, the recruitment schedule of each branch of the armed forces for active-duty enlisted soldiers who apply in November 2026 and enlist in February 2027. Please ensure that students can refer to it in fulfilling their military service obligation.

Attachment (1 file):
'26년 11월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwpx (November 2026 Active-Duty Enlisted Recruitment Plan for Each Branch, for distribution) (1 MB)

[Note: The content of the attachment was not provided and was not read for this translation.]
